description: This file defines the 'PackageBrowser' class, an Android activity that displays a list of installed packages, allowing users to view package details and delete packages. It includes inner classes such as 'MyPackageInfo', 'PackageListAdapter', and 'ApplicationsIntentReceiver' to manage package data, UI list adapter, and system broadcast reception respectively.

classes.name: PackageBrowser
classes.description: Main activity class for browsing, viewing, and deleting installed packages on an Android device.

classes.name: PackageBrowser.PackageListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class to populate and manage the list of installed packages displayed in the UI.

classes.name: PackageBrowser.ApplicationsIntentReceiver
classes.description: BroadcastReceiver subclass that listens for package installation, removal, and change events to update the package list accordingly.

classes.name: PackageBrowser.MypackageInfo
classes.description: Data structure holding package info and label for display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, adapter, and broadcast receivers.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by unregistering broadcast receiver.

methods.name: setupAdapter
methods.description: Initializes and assigns the list adapter.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu item for deleting a package.

methods.name: deletePackage
methods.description: Deletes the selected package after user confirmation.

methods.name: registerIntentReceivers
methods.description: Registers BroadcastReceiver for package add/remove/change events.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to show package details.
